criteria.given: the checked-out completion-contract files
criteria.when: the adversarial validator and its mutation tests run
criteria.then: all structure, ownership, evidence and completion invariants pass

criteria.given: a scope or criterion-definition change
criteria.when: the contract is validated
criteria.then: a matching hash lock, rationale and independent review are required

criteria.given: a blocked slice or criterion
criteria.when: the backlog is validated
criteria.then: current proof, owner, attempts, affected criteria, degraded behavior and an unblock condition exist and completion remains false

criteria.given: a completed vertical slice
criteria.when: its state is validated
criteria.then: implement, test, independent review, fix, package, live verification, documentation and commit phases all have evidence in order

criteria.given: a clean first full audit
criteria.when: the second audit begins
criteria.then: a completed remediation/rebuild iteration and newer package SHA-256 exist

criteria.given: a clean Windows install
criteria.when: Orbit is opened from Start and with Alt+Space
criteria.then: both open the same installed executable

criteria.given: AI and networking are disabled and the fixed local fixture manifest is loaded
criteria.when: the app-launch, calculation, Note, Quicklink, snippet, project and indexed-file journeys are each run
criteria.then: each journey produces its fixture-defined native result within two seconds and its empty/error fixture produces the documented non-success state

criteria.given: a fixture whose native action fails
criteria.when: the action is invoked
criteria.then: Orbit stays visible, displays the native error and records no successful usage

criteria.given: Visual Studio Code is indexed
criteria.when: Open Visual Studio Code is submitted
criteria.then: the indexed executable launches

criteria.given: the Orbit fixture project is indexed
criteria.when: Open Orbit in Visual Studio Code is submitted
criteria.then: VS Code opens the canonical Orbit repository path

criteria.given: a fixed index containing one Leonard document
criteria.when: Find the document that mentioned Leonard is submitted
criteria.then: only the real matching indexed document is returned

criteria.given: fixed successful and failed Relay sessions
criteria.when: Show failed agent sessions is submitted
criteria.then: the session screen opens with only failed sessions

criteria.given: unknown, ambiguous and unsupported fixtures
criteria.when: each request is submitted
criteria.then: Orbit shows unresolved, choice or unsupported state and never success

criteria.given: a Relay discovery fixture with opened and unopened projects
criteria.when: a scan completes and Orbit restarts
criteria.then: canonical identities persist and only genuinely opened projects have recent-use timestamps

criteria.given: a project fixture with git, context, sessions, Build Brief and handoff data
criteria.when: project details open
criteria.then: each source-backed field and latest valid handoff is displayed

criteria.given: the Orbit project and two available agent fixtures
criteria.when: Continue Orbit with the best coding agent is submitted
criteria.then: context, reasoned recommendation, plan, warnings and confirmation are shown before launch

criteria.given: a confirmed continuation
criteria.when: Relay receives the launch request
criteria.then: the exact objective, project identity and user-selected context/handoff are present

criteria.given: Relay returns a new session ID
criteria.when: launch succeeds
criteria.then: Orbit opens that ID and shows live progress, terminal status and a working stop action

criteria.given: forged renderer, model and MCP ownership/stop input
criteria.when: a protected session action is attempted
criteria.then: the native Relay boundary rejects it

criteria.given: a reachable Ollama fixture model
criteria.when: a prompt streams and is cancelled
criteria.then: non-empty tokens arrive and the native request stops within two seconds

criteria.given: Anthropic API is selected in the locked release manifest and a permitted real account credential is stored in OS secure storage
criteria.when: health, model discovery, streaming, cancellation and invalid-auth tests run
criteria.then: all produce the documented observable result

criteria.given: tool-capable and text-only provider fixtures
criteria.when: the same tool request is made
criteria.then: only the capable provider can emit a validated tool call and neither can invent execution

criteria.given: known selected text in a test editor
criteria.when: Improve this is invoked and Copy, denial, cancellation, confirmed Paste and confirmed Replace are exercised
criteria.then: source, destination and context are previewed; cancellation causes no later mutation; denial leaves text unchanged; Paste targets the declared caret; Replace changes only the selected range; and every mutation occurs only after confirmation

criteria.given: a request with multiple context sources
criteria.when: the transmission preview opens
criteria.then: every item shows source, preview, byte size, sensitivity, destination and removal

criteria.given: clipboard, selection, screenshot, repository, vault, env, key and credential fixtures
criteria.when: remote transmission is prepared
criteria.then: no sensitive item is included without explicit item-level consent

criteria.given: local-only mode, a whole-process network capture harness and an allowlist containing only loopback-local endpoints
criteria.when: AI, search, Relay, MCP, extension, diagnostics, crash, export and update journeys run
criteria.then: every Orbit process emits zero traffic outside the explicit loopback allowlist

criteria.given: generated replacement text
criteria.when: Paste or Replace targets another app
criteria.then: no target mutation occurs before explicit confirmation

criteria.given: provider, Relay, MCP, extension, diagnostics, crash and export egress adapters
criteria.when: policy coverage is enumerated
criteria.then: every adapter is deny-by-default with destination, retention and deletion rules

criteria.given: adversarial secret and personal-data fixtures
criteria.when: renderer, logs, diagnostics, crash reports and exports are inspected
criteria.then: the fixtures are absent or irreversibly redacted and deletion removes retained copies

criteria.given: a conversation fixture
criteria.when: create, rename, search, pin, archive, branch, retry, model switch, delete and export are used across restart
criteria.then: each operation has the documented durable result

criteria.given: successful, denied, cancelled and failed tool calls
criteria.when: Chat restarts
criteria.then: cards retain identity, source, canonical parameters, reason, risk, approval, bounded result, duration and error

criteria.given: one deterministic native tool and one deterministic MCP tool fixture
criteria.when: Chat proposes, previews, approves and executes each tool
criteria.then: the exact approved bounded action runs once, its real result returns to Chat, denial runs nothing, and both audit cards survive restart

criteria.given: a mission interrupted at each lifecycle state
criteria.when: Orbit restarts
criteria.then: objective, project, plan, steps, tools, approvals, outputs, verification and final result recover consistently

criteria.given: objective-bearing work and an unavailable or rejecting Relay
criteria.when: launch is requested
criteria.then: no untasked agent starts and the unavailability is shown before execution

criteria.given: the deterministic local mission fixture and certified Relay v1.1 test sidecar
criteria.when: an objective is planned, one bounded tool is approved and executed, output is verified and Orbit restarts
criteria.then: the mission reaches the honest expected terminal result and the exact objective, plan, approval, execution, verification and result recover after restart

criteria.given: native, Relay, MCP and enabled extension capabilities
criteria.when: the registry is enumerated
criteria.then: every capability has a unique stable versioned ID, schema, risk and health state

criteria.given: invalid args, duplicate identities, unknown commands and oversized output
criteria.when: execution is requested
criteria.then: validation rejects the request without native side effects

criteria.given: malicious stdio MCP configurations
criteria.when: registration or launch is attempted
criteria.then: arbitrary executables, inline scripts, argv and unapproved working directories are rejected

criteria.given: saved provider and MCP credentials
criteria.when: SQLite, settings, logs, diagnostics and exports are inspected
criteria.then: no credential material exists outside OS secure storage

criteria.given: redirect, loopback, private-address, DNS-rebinding and invalid-TLS MCP fixtures
criteria.when: HTTP MCP connects
criteria.then: each forbidden destination or identity is rejected before tool data is sent

criteria.given: slow, recursive, expensive and oversized tool fixtures
criteria.when: limits or cancellation trigger
criteria.then: native work stops at configured byte, time, step and cost bounds and output cannot authorize another action

criteria.given: simultaneous local, Relay and MCP approval requests
criteria.when: Approval Centre opens
criteria.then: every live request appears once and can be approved, denied or inspected

criteria.given: low, high and critical request fixtures
criteria.when: once, mission, project, deny and cancel are selected
criteria.then: scopes are enforced and high/critical requests remain once-only

criteria.given: an approved request bound to an atomic single-use nonce
criteria.when: request ID, tool/version, provider or server instance, executable/package hash, endpoint identity, canonical args, requester, project, destination, working directory, environment, configuration, expiry or uses change, or a replay/TOCTOU race is attempted
criteria.then: the native boundary atomically consumes the valid nonce once, denies every mutation/replay and defaults timeout to denial before side effects

criteria.given: a production build and hostile third-party/developer packages with install, update, migration, activation, helper and persisted-worker hooks
criteria.when: every install and runtime lifecycle entry point is exercised under process, filesystem and network monitoring
criteria.then: extension-controlled code runs only inside tested OS confinement or no extension-controlled code executes at any lifecycle point

criteria.given: extension execution is enabled, plus tampered packages and traversal, symlink and junction fixtures
criteria.when: install or permission access is attempted
criteria.then: integrity or canonical-path enforcement rejects them and permissions remain deny-by-default and revocable; if execution is disabled, install/update/enable controls are absent or fail closed

criteria.given: an enabled sandboxed extension or a legacy extension present before production execution was disabled, with data and a secret
criteria.when: update, disable and uninstall run
criteria.then: enabled-mode lifecycle is audited and bounded; disabled mode executes no extension code; and uninstall removes executable remnants, temp data and secrets

criteria.given: the declared keyboard and screen-reader journey list
criteria.when: it is run on the package
criteria.then: focus order, names, roles, shortcuts and visible focus pass with no keyboard trap

criteria.given: forced termination during write, stream and mission fixtures
criteria.when: Orbit restarts
criteria.then: durable state is consistent, interrupted work is honest and retries are bounded

criteria.given: the declared clean-machine dataset
criteria.when: 20 cold starts and 100 local searches run
criteria.then: p95 cold start is at most 1500 ms and p95 local search is at most 100 ms

criteria.given: an indexed fixture directory
criteria.when: a file is created, changed, renamed and deleted
criteria.then: each change appears without a full rescan within five seconds

criteria.given: a push or pull request
criteria.when: CI runs
criteria.then: contract validation, mutation tests, lint, strict typecheck, JS tests, Rust tests and Windows renderer/native builds are mandatory

criteria.given: the release commit
criteria.when: the mandatory CI workflow completes
criteria.then: every required job passes without allowed failure

criteria.given: the declared clean Windows baseline and previous Orbit version
criteria.when: MSI and NSIS install, upgrade, shortcuts, single instance, launch-at-login, restart and uninstall run
criteria.then: all pass and retained/deleted user data matches the documented policy

criteria.given: the installed app
criteria.when: diagnostics open
criteria.then: semantic version, commit, build time, executable path, Relay version/protocol/hash and degraded dependencies match the package

criteria.given: production release mode
criteria.when: signing or verified-update credentials/configuration are absent or invalid
criteria.then: the release job fails before publishing

criteria.given: protected production signing credentials for the locked Orbit publisher and the update adversarial suite
criteria.when: every executable and installer is built and wrong, expired, revoked, tampered, replayed or downgraded signatures/metadata are offered
criteria.then: every artifact validates to the expected trusted Authenticode chain with an RFC3161 timestamp, signing provenance is recorded, and the updater rejects every invalid trust root or update

criteria.given: a release artifact
criteria.when: release evidence is inspected
criteria.then: immutable commit, reproducible build record, SHA-256, SBOM, dependency scan, secret scan and malware scan are present

criteria.given: the final package
criteria.when: README, feature matrix, security model and user guidance are compared
criteria.then: every described feature and limitation matches installed behavior and foundations are labelled

criteria.given: the completed v1 package and evidence ledger
criteria.when: independent architecture, security, product and regression reviewers audit them
criteria.then: the combined report contains zero unresolved critical or high findings

criteria.given: a newer package after the remediation/rebuild iteration
criteria.when: a fresh independent full audit runs
criteria.then: the combined report contains zero unresolved critical or high findings and records independent reviewer identities
